observations: Two white-outlined figures with red circular eyes and jagged-tooth mouths occupy the center; the left figure is darker and the right is filled with pink-magenta, each topped by a small spiked crown in pink and yellow zigzag lines.
The background splits into a blue-grey hatched upper zone and a bold yellow-and-black horizontal-stripe lower zone, meeting in a hard horizon line across the lower third.
Limbs extend as thin white tubes ending in splayed multi-fingered hands; a yellow outline traces both figures, separating them from the background.
reading: Two figures face each other, their matching crowns and red eyes suggesting a pairing. The jagged teeth and splayed hands read as agitation, yet the figures lean toward each other rather than away. The striped floor anchors them in something almost theatrical, while the scratchy blue field behind them carries its own restless line work.
